text:
Maria Chen: CI is red on main — checkout step failing in job pipeline/557. Git error:
```
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
```
Looks like the checkout can't access the repo.

Samir Patel: Yep seeing same failure in matrix build. job id 557. No code changes in PR that touched submodules.

PJ: any recent secret rotations? KMS key for SECRET_DEPLOY_KEY or deploy key change?

Maria Chen: We rotated deploy credentials last night as part of infra housekeeping. I thought we updated the runners to pull from KMS, but the runner logs show `kms: decrypt failed: access denied`.

Kevin Ortiz: @PJ I can check runner IAM. Can you paste the failing command output? Also try `ssh -T git@github.com` from a debug runner.

Maria Chen: Debug run attached:
```
$ ssh -T git@github.com
git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).
```

deploy-bot: pipeline/557 failed: checkout step — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/557

PJ: I'm looking at GitHub settings -> Deploy keys. There is an entry 'ci-deploy-key' but its permissions show only `read` (no write). That would block certain operations that create refs. I also see the runner's KMS role missing `kms:Decrypt` for the key ARN.

Samir Patel: Can infra add `kms:Decrypt` for the runner role and toggle deploy key to allow write? I can rerun once fixed, or we can bisect if it persists.

PJ: I've submitted an IAM patch and updated the deploy key permission to write. Patch: infra#234. Please give it a minute to propagate.

Kevin Ortiz: Confirmed `kms:Decrypt` was missing and now added. Also updated the runner env to use the right KMS key alias.

Samir Patel: Rerunning pipeline now.

ci-bot: pipeline/557 retriggered by Samir Patel — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/557

ci-bot: pipeline/557 succeeded on rerun — checkout fixed ✅

Maria Chen: Awesome, thanks everyone. Leaving postmortem note in #incidents. :thumbsup:
